'''Wen Radler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] around [[3627 BBY]]. He was killed and eaten by the [[orlax]] [[Red (orlax)|Red]] during an outbreak on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]{{'s}} [[CI-004 Research Facility]].<ref name="OP" />
